name: Muck Mátyás — second son named András (b. 1881)
researcher_question: Did Mátyás Muck and his first wife Erzsébet Wolf of Bikács, Tolna, Hungary have a second son named András, baptized about 1881, after their first son András died in infancy in 1873?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples.csv row 19, flag adds_son, confidence 3). Resolved: true match — the hint record (ARK 1:1:VJRW-GQR/GQY, entry #44, Hungary Reformed Church Christenings) names father Mátyás Muck (farmer) and mother Erzsébet Farkas (= Wolf), a second son András born 19 Oct 1887 (christened 22 Oct), Bikács. The derivative index gets both the year (says 1881) and place (says Bogyiszló) wrong. IMPORTANT for any re-run: the underlying image ark:/61903/3:1:9392-9ZVZ-X is a multi-image group; the correct page only resolves at image index i=112 (collection/group 1858355) — the bare ARK without that index lands on a different, unrelated 1881 page, which is what happened to this fixture's first scored e2e run.
